result.Method of Attack: Backdoor implanted in liblzma code allowing attackers to intercept and modify data, potentially gaining unauthorized system privileges
result.Discoverer: A developer who posted on the OSS-security mailing list
result.Impacted Systems: Software packages depending on liblzma-sys and liblzma in crates.io ecosystem
result.Attack Vector: Supply chain attack via compromised xz-utils versions 5.6.0 and 5.6.1
